evidence_rule_zh: 只有同时具备时间、位置、朝向、观察项、去隐私照片哈希和复核人签名的记录，才计入现场证据。
evidence_rule_en: An observation counts as field evidence only when timestamp, location, direction, observation fields, privacy-cleared photo hash and reviewer sign-off are all present.
privacy_rule: Do not intentionally capture faces, licence plates, residential windows, access credentials or conversations. Blur incidental identifiers before hashing and publication.
